## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)
*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*
Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga Pācittiya 15, entitled *Seyyasanthārana* ("Not putting away bedding"), is a rule in the Theravāda Vinaya Piṭaka governing monastic property and dwellings [SuttaCentral]. According to the rule blurb, a monk who sets out or uses bedding belonging to the monastic Order in an open-air area or communal dwelling and subsequently departs without putting it away or having it put away commits an offense requiring confession (pācittiya) [SuttaCentral]. Modern translations include an English rendering by Bhikkhu Brahmali [SuttaCentral]. Secondary literature passages surfaced in the dossier do not treat this rule directly, referring instead to index entries for Nissaggiya Pācittiya or to the nun's homonymous rule Bhikkhunī Pācittiya 15.
SuttaCentral identifies widespread parallels across early Buddhist Vinaya traditions, including corresponding rules in the Bhikkhu Pātimokkha and Parivāra of the Pali canon, as well as the Prātimokṣa-sūtras and Vibhaṅgas of the Sarvāstivāda, Mūlasarvāstivāda, Mahīśāsaka, Mahāsāṅghika, and Dharmaguptaka lineages preserved in Chinese, Sanskrit, and Tibetan [SuttaCentral]. Parallels also extend to the Bhikkhunī Vinayas, such as Theravāda Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga Pācittiya 111 [SuttaCentral]. According to DharmaNexus, the text exhibits significant Pali-internal text reuse with neighboring rules in the Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga, particularly Pācittiya 14 (sharing over 5,400 characters, notably segments §2.1.8–2.2.2 with §2.1.16–2.2.3), Pācittiya 16, Pācittiya 17, and Pācittiya 18, alongside Vinaya summaries such as the *Vinayasaṅgaha-aṭṭhakathā* and *Khuddasikkhā-mūlasikkhā* [DharmaNexus]. Cross-language alignments generated by DharmaNexus further align passages of this rule with the Sanskrit *Bhikṣuṇīvinaya* and the Tibetan *Vinayasaṃgraha* (D4105) [DharmaNexus].
*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on SuttaCentral and DharmaNexus data.*
